research_scope: Dragon Burn — Ki Blast Evasive / Counter Skill.

duplicate_check.history_search: No prior repository research commit for Dragon Burn was found.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Dragon Burn as a Ki Blast Evasive and Counter Skill. The canonical skill identity therefore remains Evasive / Ki Blast; counter behavior is a separate taxonomy property.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Dragon Burn is obtained from Parallel Quest 82 — Ultimate Brotherly Battle.
verification_audit.dlc_finding: Dragon Ball Wiki identifies it as Nuova Shenron's Evasive Skill.
verification_audit.cost_finding: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference lists 200 Stamina.
verification_audit.mechanics_finding: The user enters a defensive stance and appears to ignite. An opponent who attacks during the active counter window is paralyzed and burned for about three seconds.
verification_audit.finish_policy: The reviewed evidence establishes PQ82 as the acquisition quest but does not explicitly establish an Ultimate Finish requirement for Dragon Burn; therefore ultimate_finish_required remains null.

records.name: Dragon Burn
records.skill_description: Abruptly raise your body temperature and touch enemies to set them on fire.
records.mechanics_notes: Dragon Burn is an evasive/counter hybrid: the user enters a brief stance and becomes hazardous to attackers. The Xenoverse 2 reference states that anyone who attacks during the stance is paralyzed and set on fire for three seconds. The reference categorizes it as a Ki Blast Evasive despite the counter being contact-based.
records.acquisition_notes: PQ82 is the documented Future Warrior acquisition route. No unsupported drop probability or Ultimate Finish condition is recorded.
records.pve_notes: The counter can punish enemies that attack into the active stance and applies both paralysis and burn.
records.pvp_notes: Community/guide material documents it as a punishable counter stance; exact active frames and matchup behavior are not promoted to canonical data.
